newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazilian model wakes from four-day coma.
newsitem.headline: Brazilian model wakes from four-day coma.

text.p: Top Brazilian model Claudia Liz on Saturday woke from a coma she fell into four days ago after developing an allergic reaction to an anaesthetic used for a liposuction operation on her stomach, a hospital spokesman said.
"She has pulled out of the coma and she is doing much better," said the spokesman at Israelita Albert Einstein Hospital in Sao Paulo.
He could not confirm news reports that the 27-year-old blonde was speaking with doctors, but he said she had regained some motor skills and was breathing without a respirator.
Before a liposuction operation at a clinic on Tuesday, Liz suffered a cardiac arrest that briefly interrupted the oxygen supply to her brain and left her in a coma.
She was transferred to the hospital where she had been kept on a life support system until early on Saturday when she began waking from the coma, the spokesman said.
Liz, who has a five-year-old son, married for the second time a few months ago. In addition to modelling, she has done some acting and is currently featured in a television soap opera.
